# Namal Constructions Pvt Ltd

> Namal Constructions Pvt Ltd is a premier construction company headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, building across Chennai, Coimbatore, Salem and Madurai since 2012. Services: residential construction, commercial construction, infrastructure development, renovation & remodelling, and complete interior design. 300+ completed projects, 5,00,000+ sq.ft built, 200+ professionals.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2012 (14+ years of experience)
- Head office: Plot No. VIII, Sathyamurthy Co-op. Building Society Nagar, Kathirvedu, Chennai — 600 066, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98840 00646
- Email: admin@namalconstructions.com, muthamil@namalconstructions.com
- Service cities: Chennai, Coimbatore, Salem, Madurai (and surrounding districts of Tamil Nadu)
- Construction packages (2026, all-inclusive of GST): Basic ₹2,149/sq.ft · Classic ₹2,449/sq.ft · Premium ₹2,849/sq.ft
- Typical individual-house timeline: 8–12 months from approved plan to handover
- Model: one written contract, one dedicated project manager, milestone-based payments, free site visits and consultations
- Office hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
